Tired of this matchmaking + reporting system
Aweful and extremely toxic. No matter how well you behave, after certain of won matches the game will put you into a rage, toxic and griefing snow ball for you to start losing like hell and get "balanced" and sick of course. I dont know how it really works, but it feels just like that.

The worse thing is that 90% of recent losses are directly related with this kind of behavior... I gave it the chance... Tried to ignore it hoping it can get better... But no... the game still getting you into this kind of aweful experiences.
There's something wrong.

Toxic or griefing should be punished, I mean seriously punished and also being informed to those players before getting punished like "next reported match will get you into low rank behavior matches for 1 week".

It should be just a game and it turns into a racist, toxic, griefing, bullying war for 60 mins. Without the chance to quit otherwise you will get ANOTHER punishment.

Valve/Dota team... This is serious, and getting worse. You should care about this.
